newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy September crude oil-traders.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy September crude oil-traders.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy one million barrels of crude oil in September, traders said on Tuesday.
Traders said the tender closes at 0800 hours (0230GMT) on July 24 and offers should be valid until 2200 hours (1630GMT) on July 25.
North Sea, Africa, Middle Eastern and Pacific region grades are eligible for the tender, they said.
In its August buying tender, IOC bought four cargoes of Dubai crude, a very large crude carrier (VLCC) of West African Escravos, an 80,000-tonne cargo of Gulf of Suez and two VLCCs of Qua Iboe.
